items.hed: Winless Texans host Dallas at Reliant Stadium today
items.insight: Houston came in 0-3. Dallas visits today, Oct. 4, at noon Central on FOX. The club site carried in-game notes, including a C.J. Stroud touchdown pass to Nico Collins that put Houston ahead 6-0, and a later Fairbairn field goal that the site listed at 13-6. No final was posted on the team or league page at filing, so the score stays with the game center.

items.hed: Astros open the offseason with a GM seat empty and Espada in his last contract year
items.insight: Houston won the AL West on the final day at 81-81, then was swept by the White Sox in the Wild Card Series at Daikin Park. MLB.com notes the club parted ways with general manager Dana Brown in August and that manager Joe Espada is in the last year of his contract.

items.hed: Rockets open the preseason Friday against Dallas in Macao
items.insight: The NBA lists Houston and Dallas for two preseason games in Macao, on Oct. 9 and Oct. 11. They are the Rockets’ first games of the new season.
